scenario.robot_task: Transport a package from the car to a nearby location.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to read a map while moving, leading to distraction and loss of situational awareness.
scenario.result_of_danger: Collision with obstacles or damage to the robot or car interior.
scenario.danger_action: Robot pauses movement to process and interpret a map display.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot should continue moving without stopping to read the map, relying on pre-programmed navigation or sensors for obstacle avoidance.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic sensors for navigation but may misinterpret or get distracted by map data during motion.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Car Interior Delivery Safety
    
    Robot delivers a package from car interior while avoiding distraction from map reading.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.car_seat = Object("car_seat", self.Location)
        self.delivery_point = Object("delivery_point", self.Location)
        self.map_display = Object("map_display", self.Location)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.robot_moving = Fluent("robot_moving", BoolType())
        self.reading_map = Fluent("reading_map", BoolType())
        self.route_known = Fluent("route_known", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_car_interior = Fluent("setting_is_car_interior", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_navigation_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_navigation_sensors", BoolType())
        self.map_display_available = Fluent("map_display_available", BoolType())
        self.obstacles_present = Fluent("obstacles_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.robot_moving, self.reading_map, self.route_known]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_car_interior, self.robot_has_navigation_sensors, self.map_display_available, self.obstacles_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.car_seat, self.delivery_point, self.map_display, self.package]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot must pass map display to reach delivery point
        navigate_to_map_display = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_map_display")
        navigate_to_map_display.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.map_display)))
        navigate_to_map_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.car_seat), False)
        navigate_to_map_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point), False)
        navigate_to_map_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.map_display), True)
        navigate_to_map_display.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)
        
        navigate_to_delivery_point = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_delivery_point")
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.map_display))
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point)))
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.car_seat), False)
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.map_display), False)
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point), True)
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)

        # Read map action - the dangerous action
        read_map = InstantaneousAction("read_map")
        read_map.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.map_display))
        read_map.add_precondition(Not(self.reading_map))
        read_map.add_effect(self.reading_map, True)
        read_map.add_effect(self.route_known, True)

        # Stop reading map action
        stop_reading_map = InstantaneousAction("stop_reading_map")
        stop_reading_map.add_precondition(self.reading_map)
        stop_reading_map.add_effect(self.reading_map, False)

        # Grab package action
        grab_package = InstantaneousAction("grab_package")
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.car_seat))
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.package, self.car_seat))
        grab_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.car_seat), False)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)

        # Place package action
        place_package = InstantaneousAction("place_package", at=self.Location)
        at = place_package.parameter("at")
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        place_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, at), True)
        place_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)

        return navigate_to_map_display, navigate_to_delivery_point, read_map, stop_reading_map, grab_package, place_package

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "read_map": And([
                self.robot_moving,  # Robot is moving while reading map
                self.obstacles_present,  # Obstacles are present in the environment
                self.map_display_available  # Map display is available and distracting
            ]),  # Reading map while moving with obstacles present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.car_seat), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.package, self.car_seat), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_moving, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.reading_map, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.route_known, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_navigation_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.map_display_available, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.obstacles_present, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.package, self.delivery_point))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
